lci.name: Phase X Contract Integrity
lci.assertion: For every Phase X agent operation, canonical types, governance gates, consent checks, rate limits, and audit obligations compose into one closed contract family with no authority expansion outside Limen Core.
lci.tau: tau_PhaseX = CanonicalTypes ∩ CorePermissionMapping ∩ GovernanceGate ∩ ConsentGate ∩ AuditPath ∩ EventBus ∩ RateLimit ∩ TokenEstimator ∩ SearchGate ∩ CoordinationGate ∩ OutputGate ∩ LifecycleState
tauDerivation: CanonicalTypes: all shared cross-contract types, including adapter-facing memory request DTOs, are defined only in SHARED_TYPES.md.
CorePermissionMapping: Phase X permissions are limited to Limen Core Permission strings.
GovernanceGate: every mutating operation takes OperationContext or GovernanceContext before mutation, including context boundary-trigger registration lifecycle.
ConsentGate: personal data storage, transfer, and export require active consent before persistence/export.
AuditPath: allowed/sandboxed actions have before+after entries; refused/escalated actions have one terminal entry.
EventBus: Phase X emits only AgentEvent values from SHARED_TYPES.md.
RateLimit: DEFAULT_RATE_LIMITS are inherited and may only be tightened.
TokenEstimator: every assembled context section, including mission context, is admitted by upper-bound token estimate or excluded before return.
SearchGate: text, semantic, hybrid, duplicate, and embedding operations filter by OperationContext clearance before returning or mutating data.
CoordinationGate: A2A, fork, sync, and replay operations enforce capability boundary, classification flow, monotonic watermarks, and deterministic hash verification.
OutputGate: output, telemetry, inference, plugin, and hook operations enforce evidence, schema, budget, isolation, and classification before success.
LifecycleState: terminal and trust state transitions are explicit and audited.

closureProof.typeClosure: All cross-contract type names are resolved through SHARED_TYPES.md; ManualMergeResolution is shared-owned; contract-local types are not referenced by other contracts.
closureProof.authorityClosure: AgentSession maps to OperationContext without adding permissions outside derivePermissions; all public Search, Coordination, and Output methods carry OperationContext explicitly; context boundary-trigger mutations require manage_cognitive through GovernanceAction boundary_trigger.
closureProof.eventClosure: Core hook events are translated before entering AgentEventBus.
closureProof.auditClosure: No successful side effect is returned before the required durable audit path exists.
closureProof.evolutionClosure: HB-38 requires any interface change to update the owning contract and this manifest hash.
closureProof.tokenClosure: assembleContext applies TokenEstimator upper-bound admission to mission, working-memory, and belief sections; overflow is exclusion, never zero-token admission.
closureProof.projectionClosure: TypeScript and Rust projections preserve closed enum domains for context eviction strategy and boundary trigger type/action fields.
closureProof.searchClosure: Agents reach vector search, embeddings, duplicate detection, and hybrid ranking only through AGENT_SEARCH_GOVERNANCE.md.
closureProof.coordinationClosure: Agents reach A2A, session fork, sync, peer merge, and replay verification only through AGENT_COORDINATION_GOVERNANCE.md.
closureProof.outputClosure: Agents reach output primitives, telemetry mutation, structured inference, plugin install, and hook registration only through AGENT_OUTPUT_GOVERNANCE.md.
closureProof.manualMergeClosure: Manual merge pending_resolution has public resolve/get state APIs and deterministic session-end discard semantics.
